items.title: Saints icon Charlie Austin begs FA not to ruin Southampton boss Tonda Eckert’s career with six-month spygate ban
items.summary: CHARLIE AUSTIN has pleaded with FA chiefs to leave Tonda Eckert alone and let him get on with his managerial career.
